name: Cursor
description: AI code editor where you review each agent change before accepting it.
pricing: Old $20 Pro closed to new signups Oct 12, 2026. New plans: Plus $8 (Grok models only), Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200; Claude/GPT/Gemini billed at API price.
verdict_reason: Keep old Pro if you have it; new plans may cost more once usage is billed. Disclosure: Cursor is bundled with The X Subscription (per Cursor's docs).

name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic's terminal coding agent for multi-file refactors and features.
pricing: Included in Claude Pro $20/mo ($17/mo yearly); Max from $100. Five-hour limit resets plus weekly caps.
verdict_reason: Strong pick for work that needs a whole-codebase view.

name: OpenAI Codex
description: OpenAI's coding agent for local and background 'go fix this issue' tasks.
pricing: Free tier with an agent model in the desktop app (subject to rollout); Plus $20/mo; Pro 200 allowance reduced for new subscribers since Sept 29.
verdict_reason: Best $0 starting point among the big three.

name: GitHub Copilot Pro
description: GitHub's AI pair programmer with agent mode inside popular editors.
pricing: Free, Pro $10, Pro+ $39, Max $100 a month.
verdict_reason: Budget pick: the only $10 plan with real agent usage, per DevTools Review.

name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
description: Windsurf's editor, now Devin Desktop, plus Devin Cloud agents and the SWE-2 model.
pricing: Free (light quota); Pro $20/mo; Max $200/mo; Teams $80/mo + $40 per seat.
verdict_reason: Rebrand and new SWE-2 model are fresh; give quotas time to settle.

name: Amazon Q Developer
description: AWS's AI coding assistant.
pricing: Closed to new signups since May 15, 2026.
verdict_reason: Not taking new customers.

name: Tabnine
description: AI code assistant focused on enterprise deployment.
pricing: No longer sold self-serve.
verdict_reason: No self-serve plan for individuals.

name: Lovable
description: Chat-to-app builder for websites and web apps, no coding needed.
pricing: Free: 5 daily build credits (up to 30/mo). Pro $25/mo (100 credits); Business $50/mo.
verdict_reason: Completed a project-tracker app in a published head-to-head where Bolt did not.

name: Bolt.new
description: Prompt-to-app builder in the browser by StackBlitz.
pricing: Pro $18/mo and Teams $27 per member/mo, both billed annually.
verdict_reason: Model training is on by default outside the EU/UK/CH from Oct 7, 2026.

name: v0
description: Vercel's AI app and UI builder.
pricing: Free (7 messages/day); Plus $30/user/mo; Business $100/user/mo; Premium $20 being sunset.
verdict_reason: Free tier is thin and plans just reshuffled; fine to try, wait before paying.

name: Replit
description: Cloud IDE with Replit Agent that builds and deploys apps from prompts.
pricing: Core $20/mo ($18 yearly); Pro $100/mo ($90 yearly).
verdict_reason: Completed the published head-to-head comparison alongside Lovable.

name: Base44
description: AI app builder for building apps from natural language.
pricing: Free tier; paid from $20/mo up to $200/mo per Quotadex.
verdict_reason: Not covered in the public reports we cite yet.

name: n8n
description: Fair-code workflow automation with an AI Agent node; self-hostable.
pricing: Self-host free; Cloud Starter €20/mo billed annually (2,500 executions); Pro €50/mo.
verdict_reason: Bills per workflow execution, not per step; strong default for repeat workflows.

name: AI by Zapier
description: AI step inside a Zap for tool calling and reasoning. A run that passes 75 tasks pauses.
pricing: Billed in Zapier tasks.
verdict_reason: Renamed from Zapier Agents on Oct 6, 2026: https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents-is-now-ai-by-zapier/

name: Make
description: Visual automation platform with credit-based scenarios.
pricing: Free 1,000 credits/mo; Make plan $9/mo (annual) for 5,000 credits.
verdict_reason: Cheap entry, but credits count per module action.

name: Activepieces
description: Open-source automation platform with AI pieces.
pricing: Free 100 credits/day; Plus $16/mo (yearly).
verdict_reason: Promising open-source alternative; not covered in the public reports we cite.

name: Gumloop
description: AI workflow builder billing at cost of tokens and tools plus a fee.
pricing: No free plan (14-day trial); Pro $37/mo (20,000 credits) plus 8% orchestration fee.
verdict_reason: No free plan and layered fees; try the trial first.

name: Lindy
description: Prebuilt AI assistant you customize; positioned as a Slack-native teammate.
pricing: 7-day trial with $50 credits; Team $49.99/seat/mo (5,000 credits) as of Oct 13, 2026.
verdict_reason: Pricing changed twice in October 2026.

name: Manus
description: Autonomous general agent for one-off research and analysis tasks.
pricing: Free access; Pro from $20/mo.
verdict_reason: Not verified on Manus's own pricing page for this build.

name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
description: Low-code agent builder for Microsoft 365.
pricing: $200/mo per 25,000 Copilot Credits, or pay as you go.
verdict_reason: Only makes sense if you're already on Microsoft 365 Copilot.

name: OpenAI Agent Builder
description: Visual canvas for multi-step agent workflows.
pricing: Shutting down November 30, 2026; use the API/AgentKit.
verdict_reason: Shutting down Nov 30, 2026.

name: Dify
description: Platform for building LLM apps and agents, with a cloud Sandbox tier.
pricing: Free Sandbox; paid from $590/yr per pricing index.
verdict_reason: Not covered in the public reports we cite.

name: Godot AI
description: Free MIT plugin connecting Claude Code, Codex and other agents to a running Godot editor (46 tools).
pricing: Free, open source (MIT). Needs Godot 4.7+; telemetry on by default.
verdict_reason: Voyager checked it hands-on with Claude Code and recommends it.

name: Unity AI agent plugin
description: Unity's official agent plugin for Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build (Unity 6+).
pricing: Unity AI bundled with Unity Personal (free) or Pro ($210/mo/seat).
verdict_reason: Official and promising, but the public reports we cite don't include an independent check.

name: Scenario
description: Game art generator that trains models on your own style.
pricing: 50 free daily credits (non-commercial); Starter $15/mo, Pro $45, Max $75.
verdict_reason: Strongest style consistency per Taskade's roundup; good if you have reference art.

name: Meshy
description: Text- and image-to-3D model generation.
pricing: Free 100 credits/mo, Pro $20, Premium $40, Ultra $100, Studio $70.
verdict_reason: Good for drafts.

name: Layer AI
description: Usage-based art production platform for game studios, unlimited seats.
pricing: From $10/mo for 300 Creative Units.
verdict_reason: Built for studio scale; entry tier is thin for solo devs.

name: Rosebud AI
description: No-code builder for playable browser games from prompts.
pricing: Free plan with 8,000 credits (weekly refill in eligible regions); paid tiers available.
verdict_reason: Free and fast way to try vibe-coding a game.

name: Inworld
description: Real-time voice and speech API for AI characters and NPCs.
pricing: Free on-demand tier (70 min TTS); Creator $25/mo.
verdict_reason: Needs engineering work to integrate.

name: Leonardo AI
description: 2D image generator for concept art, textures and key art.
pricing: Free 150 daily credits; Apprentice $12/mo.
verdict_reason: Not covered in the public reports we cite.

name: Ludo.ai
description: Game concepting and market research assistant.
pricing: Indie $15/mo, Pro $35/mo, Studio $300/mo, all billed annually.
verdict_reason: Niche; the paid plans are billed annually.

name: ElevenLabs
description: AI voice generation for voiceover, dialogue and sound.
pricing: Free (no commercial rights); Starter $5/mo with commercial rights.
verdict_reason: Cheap entry with commercial rights at $5.
